sources.evidence: Exact native compilation of poly: 6000 byte complete function extent after symbolic relocations. Target adds caller-owned sample_buffer parameter.
All31 float constants and17x32 dewindow table retained; initialized spans checked separately.

This early JPEG implementation has identical zigzag and initial cosine tables, private in/rgb/out/q1/q2/q3 arrays of matching extents, and explicitly zero-initialized local initdone. Its cosine initializer and surrounding emulator interface differ, so it is evidence for storage ownership rather than a replacement implementation.

notes: JPEG and fixed-point MP3 sources are reconstructed directly from target dataflow. Filenames and proprietary internal names inferred.
AziAudio ABI3mp3.cpp and mupen64plus-rsp-hle/src/mp3.c were inspected only to interpret the N64 synthesis stages; no modern replacement decoder is used.
No original x86 blobs, byte patches, dummy computation or synthetic padding are used. Compiler alignment belongs to complete measured function extents.
The integer primitives, butterfly and Mp3DCT share one inferred Mp3.c unit: VC7 uses callee information to hoist invariant calls out of the synthesis loop.

The inlined MultiplyFraction, AccumulateFraction and AccumulateUnsigned results stay 32-bit in the target caller. Their int-return declarations preserve all three out-of-line byte matches and remove unsupported caller narrowing; Mp3DCT remains unmatched.

The original contains thirteen complete 124-byte b1..b31 blocks. All 80 poly references use the ordinary private non-COMDAT block at 0x10031090. Header-only native compiler controls retain these unused constants in C and omit them in C++, while retaining t_dewindow in both languages; this independently agrees with thirteen C units and one C++ unit.

structural_evidence.dewindow: Indexing each output position and accumulating four fractional products per inner iteration produces the target's sixteen advancing input/coefficient pointers and the same sixteen-product order for the first output. Individual operand load order and complete bytes still differ.

unit_groups.evidence: A combined translation unit preserves every complete function and emits t_dewindow, JpegZigZag, JpegCosine and nch in one exact contiguous .data contribution at offsets 0, 0x880, 0x980 and 0xa80. AMP attribution is retained beside the poly implementation.
unit_groups.uninitialized_evidence: Private file-scope arrays plus explicitly zero-initialized local flags preserve all ten complete bodies and emit the exact 0x2e18-byte strong BSS extent. Flag and poly-index offsets match; inferred private array names still produce a different internal order. C++ controls split local statics into separate COMDAT sections and make res strong, unlike the target.

unit_groups.evidence: The independently constrained 14 application translation units retain one common-header dewindow table each. Including transform.h first emits the tenth table unchanged and preserves all ten exact MP3 helper and butterfly bodies. Mp3DCT remains explicitly unmatched.
